name: Élan Vital
source:
15 years ago, deep within the Amazon rain forests, a team of archaeologists discovered an ancient temple belonging to an unknown civilization. Dwelling inside lies an artifact of mysterious power as well as a series of messages in an unknown language. An exciting discovery at the time soon leads to the downfall of society as we know it. Years later a man by the name of Liam decides to step up and uncover the truth behind the events that have befallen the world. Will he be able to uncover the truth that has eluded society since the incident?

[From [url=https://camisadeprojects.carrd.co/#elanvital]official website[/url]]
translation:
15年前，在亚马逊雨林深处，一队考古学家发现了一座属于未知文明的古老寺庙。里面藏着一件具有神秘力量的神器以及一系列未知语言的信息。当时一项令人兴奋的发现很快导致了我们所知的社会的崩溃。多年后，一个名叫利亚姆的男人决定挺身而出，揭开世界上发生的事件背后的真相。他能否揭开事件发生以来一直困扰社会的真相呢？
